article.headline: Liberis' 19 points lead Saint Francis over New Haven 73-67
article.description: — Gestin Liberis' 19 points helped Saint Francis defeat New Haven 73-67 on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Liberis' 19 points lead Saint Francis over New Haven 73-67

categories.description: Saint Francis Red Flash @ New Haven Chargers

event.description: Saint Francis Red Flash @ New Haven Chargers

keywords: Saint Francis Red Flash @ New Haven Chargers
article.story: WEST HAVEN, Conn. -- — Gestin Liberis' 19 points helped Saint Francis defeat New Haven 73-67 on Tuesday night. Liberis added nine rebounds for the Red Flash (7-22, 5-11 Northeast Conference). Zion Russell shot 4 of 5 from the field, including 2 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 4 from the line to add 14 points. Skylar Wicks shot 4 of 10 from the field and 5 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points. The Red Flash snapped an eight-game skid. Jabri Fitzpatrick finished with 22 points and two steals for the Chargers (13-16, 8-8). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
